original: sāhasika, maivam | rājanvān janapadaḥ | na khalu sadbhiḥ parigṛhītā nāryaḥ svatantrā bhavanti | na hi laukikam anuṣṭhānaṃ pramāṇarahitaṃ smṛtyarthasatattvāyālaṃ bhavitum arhati | mā bhūc caityavandanādikriyāsv api tathātvam | avedavidāṃ tadanuṣṭhānād vaiṣamyam iti cet, kiṃ vā svātantryavādināṃ vedavidbhiḥ prayojanam | na khalu vedo vedavitparigrahāt pramāṇam | nāpi lokanibandhanāḥ kṛṣyādayo vedavidapekṣāḥ | sāṃdṛṣṭikaphalās ta iti cet, anyathā vā kathaṃ lokanibandhanatvam | na hy asāṃdṛṣṭikam artham āgamānapekṣo lokaḥ pratipattuṃ kṣamaḥ | atha vācakaśabdaval lokavyavahārādhīnatocyeta, tad asat | tatrārthapratyayānupapattiḥ kalpanāmūlam | iha tu kiṃ nopapadyate | vyavahārasya caityavandanādiṣv api darśanāt | na cābhiyuktamanvādismaraṇād viśeṣopapattiḥ, vyavahāramūlatve 'sadāgamair aviśeṣāt | nanu ca vedas tāvat pramāṇam ity uktam | tadvihitadarśapūrṇamāsādyanuṣṭhātāraś ca dharmaṃ praty abhiyuktāḥ | te cāṣṭakādinām anuṣṭhātāraḥ | tenetaravyavahārād vaiṣamyam | maivam, viparyayeṇa sutarām asyopapatteḥ | vedavidāṃ hi tenaiva nirākāṅkṣatvān na vyāvahārikadharmādaraḥ | parityaktavedamūlavyavahārāṇāṃ tv ananyagatikatvād vyavahāre sulagnatā | astu, teṣām api kāryateti cet, suśliṣṭam evaṃ sati prāmāṇyam |
analyzed: sāhasika mā evam rājanvān janapadaḥ na khalu sadbhiḥ parigṛhītāḥ nāryaḥ svatantrāḥ bhavanti na hi laukikam anuṣṭhānam pramāṇa rahitam smṛti artha sa tattvāya alam bhavitum arhati mā bhūt caitya vandana ādi kriyāsu api tathātvam a veda vidām tad anuṣṭhānāt vaiṣamyam iti ced kim vā svātantrya vādinām veda vidbhiḥ prayojanam na khalu vedaḥ veda vid parigrahāt pramāṇam na api loka nibandhanāḥ kṛṣi ādayaḥ veda vid apekṣāḥ sāṃdṛṣṭika

original: evaṃ tarhi codanārthānuṣṭhātṛvyavahārasāmānyād eva tatpravṛttisamarthaṃ kāraṇam anumīyatām | nanu tad eva nāstīty uktam | ata evānumīyate | kim asad apy anumīyate | na hy anumāpakaliṅgasaṃbhave saty asad iti śakyaṃ vaktum | kiṃ punas talliṅgam | traivarṇikānām asāṃdṛṣṭiko vyavahāraś codanāmūlo dṛṣṭaḥ | tathāvidhaś cāyam | tasmād atrāpy asti codanā mūlabhūteti | nāpi tadvad upalabdhiprasaṅga ity evaṃ viśeṣaṇaviruddhatvam, adarśanasyābādhakatvāt | itaravyavahāre tu vyāptyabhāvād vaiṣamyam | kim anupalabhyamānaiva codanā vyavahāraṃ pravartayati | kim anayānupayujyamānavicāraṇayā, sarvathā pravartayati | na cānupalabdhiḥ sāmānyato viśeṣataś cānumānāt | niyatakāraṇāni hi kāryāṇi tathaiva svakāraṇāny apy avagamayanti | evaṃ ca vidhyarthānuṣṭhānam upapadyate | svātantrye tu kriyānuṣṭhānam | tatra ca phalābhāvaprasaṅgo 'nantarotpādanānanvayaphalānām | na ca saṃskārotpattidvāreṇa kālāntare phalotpādakatvam iti śakyaṃ vaktum, laukikābhidhānavyāghātāt, kalpanāhetvabhāvāc ca | ato 'yam eva pakṣa śreyān | darśanāni cātrāpy upapadyanta eva |
analyzed: evam tarhi codanā artha anuṣṭhātṛ vyavahāra sāmānyāt eva tad pravṛtti samartham kāraṇam anumīyatām nanu tat eva na asti iti uktam atas eva anumīyate kim asat api anumīyate na hi anumāpaka liṅga saṃbhave sati asat iti śakyam vaktum kim punar tat liṅgam traivarṇikānām asāṃdṛṣṭikaḥ vyavahāraḥ codanā mūlaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ tathāvidhaḥ ca ayam tasmāt atra api asti codanā mūla bhūtā iti na api tadvat upalabdhi prasaṅgaḥ iti evam viśeṣaṇa viruddha t

original: nāyaṃ pakṣo nirvahaṇīyaḥ | na khalu prameyagamyāni pramāṇāni bhavanti | anuṣṭhānānupapattyā hi kāraṇaṃ kalpayataḥ kuto 'nuṣṭhānam | na hi prāk kāraṇakalpanāto 'nuṣṭhānasiddhiḥ | tatsiddhau mudhā kāraṇakalpanā | athocyeta puruṣāntarastham anuṣṭhānaṃ dṛṣṭvā tadanupapattyā kāraṇam anumāya tato 'nuṣṭhānapravṛtter adoṣa iti | tad ayuktam | na hi puruṣāntarānuṣṭhānānupapattiḥ, tasya siddhatvāt | yad apy anumānam uktaṃ kartṛsāmānyād iti, tatrāpi hetor aprayojakatvam | na hi darśapūrṇamāsādīnāṃ traivarṇikānuṣṭhānād dharmyatvam, api tu vedavihitatvāt | na caiṣāṃ tad asti | athāsāṃdṛṣṭikaṃ tadanuṣṭhānaṃ dharma iti | tad api vyabhicāri | avaidikatve 'pi viguṇadharmānuṣṭhānadharśanāt | bhrāntes tad iti cet | evaṃ saty atrāpi bhrāntyupaplavād vyabhicāraḥ | athābādhībhāvād abhrāntir ity ucyeta, tad apy asiddham | vedaviruddhe hi smṛtyarthe 'bādhādarśanāt | atha yatra tadabhāvas tat pramāṇam ity ucyeta, tad api duradhigamam | sarvaṃ cāvedavihitṃ tadviruddham evānuṣṭhānam asāṃdṛṣṭikam | ato 'yam apy asāraḥ pakṣaḥ | "sa sarvo 'bhihito vede" (MDh 2.7) ityady asaṃbaddhaṃ syāt | pramāṇarahitakāraṇakalpanāyāṃ tv andhaparamparā | nyāyokte tu darśanānām ātmalābhaḥ | "vacanāni tv apūrvatvāt" (PMS 3.5.21) ity asyāyam aviṣayaḥ | anayā diśā paricodanīyaṃ prapañcanīyam | sarvathā tu smṛtīnām aprāmāṇyaṃ mūlakāraṇānupalabdhau smṛtitvād vandhyādauhitrasmaraṇavat |
analyzed: na ayam pakṣaḥ nirvahaṇīyaḥ na khalu prameya gamyāni pramāṇāni bhavanti anuṣṭhāna anupapattyā hi kāraṇam kalpayataḥ kutas nuṣṭhānam na hi prāk kāraṇa kalpanā atas nuṣṭhāna siddhiḥ tad siddhau mudhā kāraṇa kalpanā atha ucyeta puruṣa antara stham anuṣṭhānam dṛṣṭvā tad anupapattyā kāraṇam anumāya tatas nuṣṭhāna pravṛtteḥ adoṣaḥ iti tat ayuktam na hi puruṣa antara anuṣṭhāna anupapattiḥ tasya siddha tvāt yat api anumānam uk

original: nanu tad eva vedamūlatvaṃ durupapādam ity uktam | uktā hi sarvathā vedasya mūlatvānupapattiḥ | na tat samyag uktaṃ pramāṇato hi mūlatvopapatteḥ | upalabhyate hi smṛtīnāṃ tanmūlatvam | vidhyarthānyathānupapattilabhyatvāt | tathā hi "svādhyāyo 'dhyeyaḥ" ity ukte, "vidyāṃ cādhyāpayet" iti dvayasyānupapattyānyo vidhis tatra praklapyate | "vidyām adhyāpayet" iti hi vidhir ātmopapādanāyādhyayanaṃ prayuṅkte | adhyayanvidhir api tatprayuktyaivopapannānuṣṭhāno 'dhikārāntarakalpanām antareṇaudāsīnyaṃ pratipadyate | na cādhyāpayitādhyetāram anupanīyādhyāpayituṃ kamaḥ | tatra vidhidvayopapattyarthaṃ vidhyantarānumityā "brāhmaṇādīn upanayīta" iti | evaṃ vedārthāvagatyuttarakālaṃ vidhidvaye caritārthe saty anantaraṃ prajotpādanavidhyapekṣāyā patnyabhāve tadanupapatteḥ kāmaikasādhanatvāc ca "lakṣaṇyāṃ striyam udvahet" iti (YDh 1.52) vidhyantarotthānam | agnihotrādyanuṣṭhānasya ca patnyapekṣatvāt tatsaṃnidhānāc ca "tayā saha yajeta" ity anatikramaṇavidhyudayaḥ | tathā "ṛtāv upeyat" (GDh 5.1) ityādi | tatra tatra pradhānopapādakā vidhayaḥ sādhikārā anayaiva diśā kalpanīyā | tathāṅgasaṃbandhaḥ pratyakṣair ānumanikaiś ca śrutyādibhir adhyavaseyaḥ | nipuṇatas tu granthavyākhyāyām eva pradarśayiṣyāmaḥ | na caivaṃ sati duḥśliṣṭatā smṛtiprāmāṇyasya |
analyzed: nanu tat eva veda mūlatvam durupapādam iti uktam uktā hi sarvathā vedasya mūla tva anupapattiḥ na tat samyak uktam pramāṇataḥ hi mūla tva upapatteḥ upalabhyate hi smṛtīnām tad mūla tvam vidhi artha anyathā anupapatti labhya tvāt tathā hi svādhyāyaḥ dhyeyaḥ iti ukte vidyām ca adhyāpayet iti dvayasya anupapattyā anyaḥ vidhiḥ tatra praklapyate vidyām adhyāpayet iti hi vidhiḥ ātma upapādanāya adhyayanam prayuṅkte adhyayan vidhiḥ api tad prayuktyā eva upapanna anu

original: nanu evaṃ saty arthagamyā smārthā vidhayaḥ prasajyante | tad yatha | "juhuyāt sarpiṣā" ity ukte "sruveṇāvadyati" iti ca "ājyaṃ sruveṇa gṛhṇīyāt" iti vidhyantarodayaḥ | yathā hi caturavattaviśiṣṭaḥ saripiṣā homo 'vadānasamarthadravyaviśeṣāpekṣaḥ sruvādyākāṅkṣati, tathā "sruveṇāvadyati" iti sruvavidhiḥ svaśaktyanusārād dravadravyaviṣayatayopaplavamānas tadviśeṣābhimukhatā cālocya vidhyantaram āvir bhāvayati "sruveṇājyaṃ gṛhṇīyat" iti | evañjātīyakāḥ sarve vidhayaḥ smārtāḥ prasajyeran |
analyzed: nanu evam sati artha gamyā smārthāḥ vidhayaḥ prasajyante tat yathā juhuyāt sarpiṣā iti ukte sruveṇa avadyati iti ca ājyam sruveṇa gṛhṇīyāt iti vidhi antara udayaḥ yathā hi catur avatta viśiṣṭaḥ saripiṣā homaḥ vadāna samartha dravya viśeṣa apekṣaḥ sruva ādi ākāṅkṣati tathā sruveṇa avadyati iti sruva vidhiḥ sva śakti anusārāt drava dravya viṣaya tayā upaplavamānaḥ tad viśeṣa abhimukha tā ca ālocya vidhi antaram āvis bhāvayati sruveṇa

original: maivam, eśā viniyogamātrāvasāyitvāt | yo hy utpādakḥ padārthasyānuṣṭhāpako vā syāt, sa evopadeśakāraṇam | na tūtpannaidamarthyamātraniyāmako 'pīty avirodhaḥ | evaṃ tarhi smṛtiviniyuktānām apy asmārtatvaprasaṅgaḥ | na, smṛteḥ padārthotpādakatvena vaiṣamyāt | kā vārtāṣṭakādiṣu | na tadabhāve kasyacid vider anupapatiḥ | svādhyāyādhyayanavidher mantrāṇāṃ copapannatvāt | ucyate | atrāpy aṣṭakādisamākhyātamantravān svādhyāyādhyayanavidhir nopapadyate | na hi japayajñādyanvaye sati samākhyānopapattiḥ | na ca spaṣṭataraviniyogopalabdhiḥ, yadbalenākhyāyā bādhaḥ | śakyate ca mantrair dravyadevatāsaṃyogo 'dhikārahetutvaṃ ca pratipādayitum | tadyuktādhyayanavidhyanupapattitaś ca kāryatāvamagaḥ | aṅgānvayaprakāras tūkta eva | nanu evaṃ samākhyānābhedād aśeṣair mantrair ekam evāṣṭakākarmānumīyeta | maivam, sāmarthyabhedāt | svaśaktyā hi mantrāḥ karma pratipādayanti | na caikakarmapratipādanaśaktir asti | ataḥ siddho 'ṣṭakādikarmaṇāṃ bhedaḥ | na caivaṃ saty aśeṣaśākhādhigatāṣṭakādyanuṣṭhānam ekasyaiva syāt | na khalv ekaśākhādhigatakriyānuṣṭhāne tadakaraṇanimittapratyavāyo na parihṛtaḥ syāt | paṭhyamānatve hi karmaṇāṃ bhinnānāṃ samānanāmnām apy ekakriyāyām akṛtī syāt, kartavyatāvagateḥ samānatvāt, prayojanaikyānavagamāc ca | anumeyatve tad anupapannam, aṣṭakādyabhinnakālasaṃbandhinas tadanusāreṇa prayojanasyābhedāt | avagatakālādisaṃbandhāvirodhena hi prayojanaṃ kalpanīyam | tac cānekakarmānuṣṭhāne 'nupapannam | na hy ekasmin kāle 'nekakarmānuṣṭhānopapattiḥ | na cānumeyatve pūrvāhṇādikālasyāṅgatvakṛtaḥ kaścid viśeṣo 'sti, paṭhyamānavat | kiṃ ca paṭhyamānaṃ karmātmānaṃ kārayitum akriyāyāṃ pratyavāyaṃ kalpayati | kālpanikaṃ punaḥ paṭhyamānany athānupapattyā kalpyeta | tac ca kalpyakarmānanuṣṭhānanimittadoṣakalpanām antareṇaivopapannam iti na kalpanāvasaro 'sti | atha kḷptakarmānuṣṭhānāvagamānupapattyā kalpyeta, tadaivaṃrūpā kalpanā syad: yo hy asmin kāle 'ṣṭakākhyaṃ karma na kuryāt sa pratyaveyād iti | evaṃ sati tadākhyaikakarmakaraṇe 'pi kṛtī syāt | na caikaikatra kalpanāhetusadbhāvād anekakalpanāprasaṅga iti śakyaṃ vaktum | tasyaikakalpanāyām apy avirodhāt | athāgṛhyamāṇaviśeṣatvād anekakalpanam ity ucyate | tad ekaśākhāpaṭhyamānaviṣayatvād ekaikaśākhādhigatatve 'nupapannam | na hi bhinnaśākhādhigatatve 'py agṛhyamāṇaviśeṣatāsti | paṭhyamāne 'py etat samānam iti cet | na, tasya svamahimnaivānuṣṭhāpakatvāt | iha tu svarūpasyānyato 'dhigater vaiṣamyam | kiṃ ca, anuṣṭhānopapattyarthā kalpanā | na caikakartṛviṣayatayā sarvakarmānuṣṭhānābhyupagame tadupapattiḥ | na hi svahetuvirodhinyaḥ kalpanāḥ saṃbhavanti | pratyakṣādhyayane tv aprādhānyāt kālasya prasaktāv api virodhaḥ parihriyeta, na tv anumeyatve 'pi | ataḥ sūktam ekakaraṇe 'pi kṛtī syād iti | virodhādarśanāt tu catasro 'ṣṭakāḥ kriyanta ity anavadyam | evaṃ ca sāmānyataḥ kāryāvagamaḥ | kvacic ca pratyakṣato 'pi paṭhyamānatvena sāmānyataḥ kāryāvagatau mantrārthavādā viśeṣasamarpakā bhavanti | tāny api smṛtimūlāni | yathā, "etad u khalv addhā tapaḥ yad ahiṃsā yad damo yad dānaṃ yad atithisaparyā | atha paramaṃ tapo bhūtānām yad anujighṛkṣā tasmād evaṃvit sarveṣāṃ bhūtānām addhaivopakuryād" iti brāhmaṇam | addhopakāraś ca dṛṣṭakāraṇarahita upakāraḥ | tadapekṣitaprakāraviśeṣo mantrārthavādair anyaparair api pratipādyamāno nāpeśalaḥ | yathā, "sthalayodakaṃ parigṛhṇanti" iti taṭākādikaraṇam | "dhanvann iva" (RV 10.4.1) iti ca prapākaraṇam | yat tu phalavat prayogāntargateḥ kalpyamānasyāpi tādarthyam iti | talliṅgena prakaraṇasya bādhyamānatvād acodyam | yamaniyamās tu prāyaśaḥ pratyakṣamūlā eva | yatra punaḥ pratyakṣaṃ tadanupapattau kḷptaṃ vā na sāmānyakaraṇam asti, tatrāpy anyaparatvān mṛṣārthatvena copapannatvān na mantrārthavādāḥ svānvitapadārthasatyatābhājo bhavanti | tenāsadāgamair vaiṣamyam | smṛtayo 'pi ca tadrūpā eva bādhyante | na caitāvatā samūlatve 'pi tanmithyātvakalpanety alaṃ prasaṅgena | sarvathā vedamūlatvaṃ smṛtinām upapannam | śakyate caiva sati smṛtīnām avijñātatvaṃ vaktuṃ, kālpanikatvāt | kalpanānimittam evargvedādayaḥ, na vyapadeśakāraṇam | tathā ca manuḥ: "sa sarvo 'bhihito vede" (MDh 2.7) ityādyabhidhānamantraṃ bruvan kalpyatvād vidher vedavyapadeśo nāstīti darśayati, āpastambaś ca "brāhmaṇoktā vidhayas teṣām utsannāḥ pāṭhāḥ prayogād anumīyante" (ĀpDh 1.12.10) iti vadaṃs teṣāṃ mūlasatyatām | utsannā iva prayogād anumīyanta original: dṛṣṭāntārthaṃ śrautavacanam | yathaiva śrautam agnyantare kriyamāṇam akarmaiva syād, evaṃ smārtam akṣatahomānnapākādi | vaivāhikaś cāgniś caturthyuttarakālam, tenaiva patnyarthāvāpteḥ, patnīvataś cādhikārāt | dāyavibhāgakālāhṛte vā | apiśabdāt kālāntarāhṛte 'pi | yathā vidyamānapatnīkasya patnyantaramaraṇe | patnyantarotpāde tu vaivāhikavacanād eva siddhiḥ | tathā ca gautamaḥ: "bhāryādir agnir dāyādir vā" iti (GDh 5.7) | nanu ādhānādhikṛtasyāyaṃ kālavidhiḥ | na, vidyamānāgneḥ patnyantarotpādamātreṇādhikāraḥ | tasyā evādhikāra iti cet, na, sahatvāsaṃbhavāt | tadanurodhāt sahatvāpattir iti cet, na, agnimattvāt, tattyāgāsaṃbhavāc ca | nanu evam api madhyakaṃ dravyaṃ katham ivaikas tyaktuṃ kṣamaḥ syat | maivam | yathaiva rajasvalāyāṃ patnyām ekāky eva yajamānas tyajed vacanāt tadanujñāmātreṇa, evam atrāpīty adoṣaḥ | tathaiva cāsau kārayitavyā, yathātmīyasaṃbandhaṃ na virodhāya kuryāt | yad vā dravyābhāva evāsyāḥ, kutaḥ | asmād evānadhikārāt | maivam | na hi kratvarthaṃ dravyārjanaṃ, puruṣārtham eva | tac cānadhikāre 'py avyāhatam eva | "bhasadāhavā etāḥ paragṛhāṇām aiśvaryam avarundhate" iti śruteḥ | adhikārānapekṣo hi dravyasaṃbandhaḥ | satyam | sa tu pūrvatarajyeṣṭhāyā eva | tadatikramāc ca pariṇītāpy asvāminy eva, veśyāvat | nanu adhivedananimitte saty ūḍhā katham itvāsvāminī syāt | ucyate | dvividhaṃ hy adhivedanam, dharmaprajāpāyarūpatvāt | tatra dharmāpāye paraiva syāt, na pūrvā | prajāpāye tu kuto dharmādhikāraḥ | atrocyate | aho sūkṣamadarśitvam ācāryavataḥ | dharmaprajāpāyāvadhivedanaṃ prayuñjāte | na tv adhivinnāyās tādarthyam āpādayataḥ, pramāṇābhāvād, anyad dhi tādarthyam anyā ca prayuktir yataḥ | tatra "anyatarāpāye dārān kurvīta" iti smṛter arthaḥ | dāratvāc ca taduddeśavihitaṃ dravyādi katham iva na syāt | ato nāsvāmitvam | yat tūktaṃ tadanujñayaiva karaṇam iti | tad apy asat, pūrvāgnivināśāt | kuto vināśa iti cet, kārakatvāpāyāt | patnīyajamānayor hi kārakaikyaṃ vā syāt, bhedo vā | dvidhāpi ca dravyāntaropādānād vināśaḥ, agnīṣomavat | nanu ayaṃ doṣaḥ kārakānupraveśe sati syāt | vayaṃ tv anupraveśam eva vārayāmaḥ | apāyas tu siddhe kārakatva iti vaiṣamyam | maivam | na śakyaḥ svecchāmātreṇānupraveśaḥ phalotsāhāviśeṣāt prasajyamāno vārayitum | yadi hi kartṛtvapūrvo 'dhikāraḥ syāt, tatas tadanupapattyā vāryetāpi | adhikārapūrvake tu kartṛtve durnivāro 'nupraveśaḥ | tataś ca pūrvakārakavināśāt tadāhitāgnivināśaḥ | tataś ca siddho nimittāntarābhāvād vivāha eva punar agnyutpādaḥ | tathā ca nyāyamūlaiva smṛtiḥ: "āhṛtoḍhāyāṃ punar ādadhīta" ity alam atyabhidhānena | ataś
